summary: Normalizes a 4-component 3D audio listener orientation vector using 3DNow! packed single-precision math. Reads the two 64-bit halves of the input a2, extracts the 4th component (high dword of a2[1]) and tests it against packed 1.0. When the 4th component is >= 1.0 the input is copied to the output unchanged. Otherwise it runs SquareRootApproximation and a 3DNow! helper, then, when the absolute 4th component exceeds a small threshold (0x34000000 packed), refines a reciprocal via pfrcp/pfrcpit1/pfrcpit2 (Newton-Raphson) and scales both input halves by it, finally masking the second half with a low-dword quad mask before writing the normalized result to a1.

local_names.a1: output listener orientation vector (two packed 32-bit halves)
local_names.a2: input listener orientation vector (two packed 32-bit halves)
local_names.m64_u64: first 64-bit half of the orientation vector
local_names.v4: second 64-bit half of the orientation vector
local_names.v5: 4th component duplicated into both lanes via punpckhdq

operations.description: Flush MMX/3DNow! floating-point state (_m_femms) on entry and again before returning.
Read both 64-bit halves of the input orientation vector: m64_u64 = a2->m64_u64 and v4 = a2[1].
Extract the 4th vector component: v5 = punpckhdq(v4, v4) duplicates the high dword of the second half into both lanes.
Guard on pfcmpge(v5, packed 1.0, 0x3F8000003F800000): when the 4th component is >= 1.0 the normalization path is skipped and the input is copied through directly.
Call SquareRootApproximation(0, a2) to obtain a reciprocal-square-root estimate of the vector magnitude; its return value is ignored.
Save the low dword of the extracted component: v9 = cvtsi64_si32(v5).
Call sub_529700(), a 3DNow! helper that contributes to the orientation refinement; no arguments are passed per the raw source.
Re-read both halves of the input a2 after the helper calls, refreshing m64_u64 and v4.
Guard on pfcmpge(pand(v5, absolute-value mask 0x7FFFFFFF7FFFFFFF), small threshold 0x3400000034000000): normalization scaling runs only when the absolute 4th component clears the threshold.
Newton-Raphson reciprocal refinement: v7 = pfrcp(v5), then v8 = pfrcpit2(pfrcpit1(v5, v7), v7) folded through the low dword lane v6 = cvtsi32_si64(v9).
Scale both halves of the orientation vector by the refined reciprocal v8: m64_u64 = pfrmul(m64_u64, v8) and v4 = pfrmul(v4, v8).
Write the result: result->m64_u64 = m64_u64 (output this+0x0) and result[1].m64_u64 = v4 AND 0xFFFFFFFF low-dword quad mask (output this+0x8).
Return the output pointer a1 (after the trailing _m_femms).
